title: Establish the dictionary foundation
detail: Imported Kaikki/Wiktionary definitions with source links and awaiting-review labels. Search works in both directions. Done: meanings and attribution preserved.

title: Keep the roadmap and backups
detail: Kanban cards can move between columns. Browser edits and tasks can be exported and restored. Done: a durable plan file and backup controls exist.

title: Build Unanu/Namonuito vocabulary separately
detail: Ask the speaker for Unanu/Namonuito words, island-specific spellings, and English meanings. Done: ten nmt-tagged records reviewed or flagged with sources; never relabel chk imports as nmt.

title: Choose spelling and dialect conventions
detail: Ask the speaker which island/dialect and spelling conventions they use. Done: document preferred spelling, variants, and when to retain source spellings.

title: First ten-word conversation
detail: When the speaker is available, download the review sheet. Check meanings and natural usage; record initials and notes. Done: ten entries reviewed or flagged, with a backup saved.

title: Audit imported entries
detail: Check extraction warnings, unusual entries, duplicate meanings, and missing forms against original pages. Done: issues logged and resolved or visibly flagged.

title: Build everyday vocabulary
detail: Prioritize greetings, family, food, home, school, work, and travel with the speaker. Done: agree a topic list and review 50 useful entries; retain sources.

title: Collect paired sentences
detail: Gather original Chuukese sentences with English meanings, context, and permission. Done: 50 reviewed sentence pairs and notes about grammar and intended meaning.

title: Pronunciation recordings
detail: Agree speaker consent and recording ownership before adding audio. Done: ten approved recordings linked to reviewed entries with pronunciation notes.

title: Shared saving across devices
detail: Choose a private shared database and speaker access after the review workflow is proven. Done: login, cross-device saving, restore checks, and an edit history.

title: Test sentence translation
detail: Use reviewed sentences and grammar to choose a translation approach. Done: evaluate both directions on held-out speaker-reviewed examples and display uncertainty. Requires the sentence collection; API setup only if needed.

title: Verify Standard Chuukese spelling
detail: Check imported Chuukese spelling and usage against the preferred standard and speaker guidance. Done: agreed conventions recorded and nonstandard/uncertain forms labeled. Imported chk does not mean standard verified.
